reviewContext.userProblem: The Nodetto desktop app has only a light UI: there is no app theme setting, the chrome CSS is full of hard-coded light colours, the canvas cannot be dark, and PCB pages (whose layer colours are tuned for a dark board) render on a light canvas.
requiredOutcomes: Settings shows an Appearance category directly after General, with Theme (System/Light/Dark), Canvas (Light/Dark/Match theme) and PCB canvas (Dark/Light/Match theme) selects; choices persist in nodetto.editor.preferences.v1 and apply live (design 3.1, 3.4; plans 01, 06).

Preference parsing tests cover defaults (system/light/dark), round trip, invalid values per key, a stored v1 payload without the new keys and the legacy nodetto.view.show-rulers path (design 6; plan 01).

System theme follows macOS appearance and updates live via watchSystemTheme; the theme is applied in main.tsx before render; the native title bar follows the theme through Window.setTheme with core:window:allow-set-theme (design 3.3; user QA Q2; plan 06).

A complete dark chrome token set in base.css under :root[data-nodetto-theme="dark"] mirroring the light block; no colour literal left in desktop chrome CSS outside token blocks, enforced by theme-tokens.test.ts (design 4.1, 4.2, 6; plans 03, 07).
ui-solid chrome CSS uses var(--token, <today's literal>) so nodetto-cloud renders unchanged with only light tokens (design 4.3; plan 05).

NodettoCanvas gets an optional canvasBackground {diagram, pcb} prop and the nodetto-canvas-dark class; PCB pages are dark by default, diagram pages light by default, Match theme follows the resolved theme (design 5.1; plans 02, 06).
Canvas background, dot grid, rulers and overlays use canvas tokens with light and dark sets; a document paint pin keeps element defaults light in every theme (design 5.2, 5.3; plan 04).
README feature list gains one appearance line (design 7; plan 06).
BUN_OPTIONS=--jsx-runtime=classic mise run verify passes and mise run build succeeds.
nonGoals: Theming document elements or a dark variant of element default paint (user QA Q1 default).

Edits to packages/ui-solid/src/shapes/pcb-view.ts, PcbShapeView.tsx, PcbOverlay.tsx, BreadboardOverlay.tsx, TextEditor.tsx, the PCB layer colour table, any export module, or packages/ui-solid/src/shapes/*.css.
A separate KiCad-navy PCB canvas set (user QA Q3 alternative); the PCB dark canvas uses #15191b.
tauri.conf.json changes, Rust changes, new npm dependencies, version bumps, nodetto-cloud's own theme, server/auth/deployment code.
constraints: A parallel branch owns pcb-view.ts, PcbShapeView.tsx and the PCB layer colour table; the PCB dark look comes only from the canvas background.
Stored element colours are never inverted or rewritten; SVG, PNG, PDF and JSONL exports take no input from appearance state (design invariant 1; theme-tokens case 7).
Default diagram rendering stays identical (light canvas, unchanged light token values); the only default change is the dark PCB canvas (design invariant 2).
Selection outlines, handles, guides, comments and presence stay visible on both canvases (overlay >= 3:1); panel text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 in both themes (design invariant 4).
packages/ui-solid must work with only today's light tokens and no new prop; new code typechecks under noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
English only, no emojis, cargo with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, no version bump, no unrelated file changes.

Workers follow impl-plans/active/appearance-00-overview.md 'Per-worker protocol' rules 1-9: sha256 before/after edits, intent snapshot, edit only writePaths/sharedPaths and own progress log, no state-changing git, no workspace-wide formatter, foreground commands without tee/head pipes, shared-input gates count only when same-wave siblings show STATUS: done otherwise recorded as pending-join and rerun in reconciliation.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Theme applied through data-nodetto-theme on <html> plus root color-scheme, set in main.tsx before render because the CSP forbids an inline script in index.html (design 3.3).
base.css is the only file declaring chrome colour values; new tokens take the exact literal they replace so light rendering is unchanged (design 4.1, 4.2).

Canvas mode is resolved in the desktop app and passed as already-resolved light/dark per page kind; ui-solid knows nothing about match or the app theme, so nodetto-cloud keeps a light canvas (design 5.1).
Canvas tokens are independent of the chrome theme so a light canvas under a dark theme stays light (design 5.2).
The paint pin re-declares six tokens as literals plus color and color-scheme: light because color and color-scheme inherit as computed values from :root (design 5.3, DR-1).
ui-solid fallbacks equal today's literals byte for byte, so nodetto-cloud renders the same bytes (design 4.3).

Button tokens move from buttons.css into base.css; undeclared var() fallbacks (--line, --surface, --ink, --nodetto-border, --nodetto-panel-bg, --nodetto-text) are replaced by declared tokens, never just dropped (plan 03, F-S5-01).
base.css is written serially: plan 03 (wave 1), plan 05 append-only (wave 2), plan 07 dark values only (wave 3).
intentionalTradeoffs: On a dark diagram canvas, elements without stored colours keep dark default strokes so the canvas matches exports (user QA Q1).

With Dark selected, the native title bar follows via setTheme; switching from an explicit theme back to System can briefly resolve against the previous window theme until the watcher re-reads matchMedia (step5 residual low).
Workers choose dark values for new tokens; plan 03/05 contrast scripts and plan 07 WCAG case are the backstop, and plan 07 may adjust dark values only.
Some per-plan gates are pending-join and move evidence to reconciliation, which must rerun all of them.
supportedEdgeCases: Stored preferences without the new keys, with invalid values per key, malformed JSON, blocked storage, and the legacy show-rulers key (plan 01).
matchMedia unavailable: systemDark defaults to false; setTheme rejection is caught and the CSS theme still applies (plan 06).
NodettoCanvas without canvasBackground or with an undefined page kind renders light (plan 02).
Light canvas under dark chrome and dark canvas under light chrome; Match theme for either canvas setting (plans 01, 04, 06).
Comment pin white border and presence label ink #fffdf8 are fixed tokens that read on both canvases (design 5.4).
@media (forced-colors: active) blocks in base.css keep parsing in the token test (plan 07).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live macOS appearance switching and native title bar rendering are checked manually only.
Inline colours in PcbOverlay.tsx, BreadboardOverlay.tsx and PresenceOverlay.tsx stroke attributes.
nodetto-cloud dark theme; export dialog background default.
residualRisks: low: plan 06 re-reads matchMedia after setTheme; switching from an explicit theme back to System may briefly resolve against the previous window theme.
Serial repair may be needed for plan 07 findings against plans 03, 04 or 05.
Live macOS appearance switching and the native title bar can only be checked manually.
